Directions: For items 84 - 87, choose the best alternative which is written with correct punctuation and capitalization.

We are going to guba see the great Renaissance Dam in September.
options: We are going to guba see the great Renaissance Dam in September.
We are going to guba to see the Great Renaissance Dam in September.
We are going to Guba to see the Great Renaissance Dam in September.
We are going to Guba to the see the great Renaissance Dam inSeptember.
explanation:
Capitalize proper nouns: 'Guba' and 'Great Renaissance Dam'.
 Include 'to' after 'going'. Correct spacing and grammar.
